candidate_structure.information_flow: The boundary call receives all common inputs and emits one implementation-erased map containing public interface obligations, validity obligations, and cross-objective behavioral tensions. The final call consumes only that immediately preceding map, preventing anchor implementation, reversible edit history, and terminal compression evidence from entering policy construction.
candidate_structure.name: Anchor-Erasure Clean-Room Relay
candidate_structure.organization: Two-call sequential relay separated by one lossy visibility edge; the first call is an abstraction boundary and the second is the sole policy producer.

calls.objective: Project the supplied evidence into one contract-level causal tension map while preserving public interface, authoritative-state, capacity, determinism, and standard-library obligations. Exclude anchor implementation details, repair sequences, reversible deltas, policy fragments, cases, traces, scores, and alternative candidates.

Consume the immediately preceding implementation-erased map as the sole visible evidence and construct one complete, internally coherent, contract-compliant policy artifact addressing its behavioral tensions together. Do not reconstruct or edit the anchor, inherit reversible repair or compression, create alternatives, or perform review-based selection.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: anchor-relative reversible repair lineage with terminal causal compression
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: contract-grounded clean-room whole-policy synthesis behind an anchor-implementation erasure boundary
rejected_assumptions: The anchor implementation is the necessary coordinate system for every valid structural improvement.
Causal accountability must be represented through an ordered reversible checkpoint-patch lineage.
Whole-policy coherence is best recovered by terminal compression of locally accepted edits.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Insert one lossy anchor-implementation erasure edge before the sole policy-producing call so that only a contract-level behavioral tension map crosses into construction.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: The emitted policy should express a jointly coherent response across scan resistance and phase shifts without preserving anchor-local choices merely because they possess reversible edit evidence.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The active family binds causal evidence to anchor-relative reversible edits, so cross-objective behavior can remain path-dependent even after terminal compression.

structural_mutation.after: An abstraction call projects the common inputs into a contract-level behavioral tension map, while the final policy call receives only that map and cannot see anchor implementation details, repair ordering, deltas, or policy fragments.
structural_mutation.before: The sole producer retains direct anchor implementation visibility throughout reversible repair and terminal causal compression.
structural_mutation.factor: lossy anchor-implementation erasure edge before policy construction
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation creates a concrete one-way visibility boundary that changes what final construction can causally depend on; the additional call exists solely to enforce this information cut rather than to review, select, or finalize another producer's work.

validation.factor: lossy anchor-implementation erasure edge before policy construction
